content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble with [product_name]. After downloading the project to the micro SDHC card, I can't see it in the web server. Could someone assist? When I open the web server, it doesn't load the HTML page. Thanks.
Hello [user_name], I've loaded your [product_name] project and program to my [product_name] without issues. The project appears in the web server as expected.

Hi, The [product_name] supports custom web pages. When accessing the controller's IP address in your browser, make sure to enable the option for displaying customized sites. Refer to the attached image. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges displaying their project created with [product_name] after deploying it via microSD card, as the custom HTML page does not appear on the device's web server. Another user confirms that the setup works correctly when configured properly, and a further suggestion is made to verify that the customized site setting is enabled.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that after deploying their [product_name] project to the controller, the custom HTML page will be accessible and automatically displayed through the built-in web server.
